notes: The existing site is a single page with anchor navigation for Home, About, Portfolio, Team and Contact.
All three original portfolio images contain embedded logos, captions and social badges. Display them without cropping, using consistent frames and object-fit: contain.
No biographies, working social profiles or individual contact details are supplied for team members.
The contact section uses Warm Spring Road; the footer uses Warm Springs Road. This migration uses the footer spelling.
Generic template footer links, stock service labels and nonfunctional social links are omitted from the new navigation.
The original skill progress percentages are preserved in sourceSkills as archival content; they are self-reported template-style figures, not verified metrics.
Only copy cleanup, spelling corrections and presentation changes were made. No project results, qualifications or business claims have been invented.
